selection_policy: Choose and validate providers per dataset. Use one primary provider; enable a fallback only after verifying equivalent semantics, geographic coverage, freshness, terms, and quotas. Record the provider used in every output.

primary.notes: Live request returned precipitation and precipitation_probability. Official openmeteo-requests Python client is available. Free API is non-commercial only; commercial plan/terms must be confirmed before product use.

fallbacks.notes: Requires a separate API key and verification of forecast fields, quota, attribution, and terms. Do not combine probabilities without calibration.

candidates.notes: Verify Ho Chi Minh City coverage, motorcycle vehicle value, credentials, quota, and route behavior before selection.
